paper_id: Accurate CPU Power Modeling for Multicore Smartphones
title: Accurate CPU Power Modeling for Multicore Smartphones
motivation: 智能手机多核CPU功耗模型误差高达34%,现有方法不考虑idle power states
problem_framing: 把CPU功耗建模问题重新定义为需考虑idle power states的回归问题
key_insight: 加权平均idle state驻留时长WED_Ci能准确预测多核CPU功耗
evaluation_criteria: 功耗估算精度(98%)和稳定性(variation<5%)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 仅考虑CPU,未建模GPU功耗;视频解码实验精度降至90%
evidence_for_taste: same frequency/utilization, power difference can reach 50%
Simply considering durations or numbers of entries does not work
Even when portion of each idle state duration is fixed, CPU could have more than 20% variation
CPU idle states play a less critical role in old single-core smartphones
thinking_moves: 从实测异常反推现有模型的隐含假设失效
先证简单扩展法不可行(duration/entry数都不够)
提出加权度量WED消除噪声
从单核模型逐步扩展到多核
用benchmark和real app双重验证稳定性
cites_own_work: [28] Towards Better CPU Power Management on Multicore Smartphones. Hotpower 2013
